statement: Vector 1 must prove code to contract: every changed unit in the diff is accounted for against the captured contract.
Every changed leaf is assigned exactly one accounting state, with attribution edges tying ranges to claims.
A mechanical changed-range census is the denominator for accounting.
A confirmed unclaimed unit becomes a grouped Vector 1 blocking finding the owner must address in the PR body.
A newly declared behavior changes the contract and lands as a recapture or new state at closure.
Additive schema and format support carries unclaimed-delivery, coverage refs, evidence anchors, severity rules and coverage totals.
Yagni removes the untraceable-hunk atom and the traceable-equals-NOT-A-HIT dismissal; hunk accounting is V1's job.
Yagni refocuses on whether the engineering used to deliver claimed behavior is justified, as an optional, fresh-context, non-blocking LOW/MED lens.
The coverage ledger and claim registry are coordinator-owned paged notebook pages, the authoritative store with no ambient scratch/global state.
A notebook-less fallback cannot assert complete coverage.
In-diff spec/design material enters the contract only through an explicit pointer, and repository convention interprets but never authorizes a designated package.
Before any Vector 1 spend, a bounded within-/cross-source consistency pass compares material purpose/scope/behavior declarations.
A material unresolved contradiction without explicit precedence provisionally marks repair_required and defaults the run to pause before Vector 1.
The narrow exception to the pause is an operator-recorded, named, bounded evidence-only Vector 1 run.
After Vector 1, completion is a review-basis gate of ready/limited-only/blocked/unknown plus a separate repair_required.
Accounting completeness is not itself a readiness verdict, and limited-only/blocked/unknown cannot reach ordinary V2/V3 without explicit named operator authorization.
A contract-only repair is a new review state, never an in-place reconciliation.
Phase 0 runs on the standalone cure_light_census plugin (Option A) exposing census_run/census_check, claims_prepare to labeling children to claims_finalize, and gate_check.
The plugin is pinned against its own dist/TOOL.json version plus describe_sha256/artifact.sha256 and fails closed on PIN_MISMATCH.
There is no artifact fetch, no .pyz, and no python/uv/tree-sitter dependency in the substrate.
The Python tools/ prototype is retired.
The plugin gates claim-registry completeness only, while the coordinator owns the census-claim join, roles/precedence, leaf fractioning, states, exclusions and coverage ledger.
Designated claim sources must be Markdown; a designated non-Markdown source is captured context with a stated limitation.
docs/contract-adequacy-validation-plan.md is explicitly designated as an in-diff claim source whose F1-F10 clauses are its operative content, delivered by this PR.
Mechanical completeness is always required, partial acceptance is explicit, exclusions are evidence-linked (never suffix rules), and a thin/empty contract stops planning.
Docs-only spec rewrites are real deliverables via documents/specifies against an independent anchor; declares is provenance, never an EXPLAINED edge, with no self-proof or cycles.

A worker-authored proposal is the run's recorded evidence: the coordinator never overwrites, repairs or normalizes it into the authoritative submitted file, and on invalid output retains the original, obtains a new worker-authored proposal, or stops and escalates.

The plugin's bundled slice instructions are the operational worker contract, bundle source is for diagnosis only, and insufficient published instructions stop Phase 0 as a substrate defect reported to the plugin maintainers.

A verified registry is complete under one review state's captured sources, instructions, labels and tool pins; cross-run differences are diagnostic only and fixed model/temperature or gold labels are not required for V1.
The written verbatim contract-<owner>-<pr>-s<n> page (or prescribed disk fallback) is verified to exist, read and match the manifest's contract_ref at the Phase-0 gate.
The substrate pin advances 1.0.0 to 1.0.2 in lockstep with published release v1.0.2 and is single-version, so a run prepared under one version is never verified, reused or mixed under another.
The F1 stamped-spec happy path expects every unit attributed/explained with no self-proof and no UNCLAIMED unit.
The F2 un-stamped lookalike compiles no claims from the lookalike, permits no invented claim, records repair_required, and leaves affected units UNCLAIMED.

The F3 material contradiction is recorded with exact quotes, byte offsets, source hashes and affected claim IDs plus a materiality witness, sets provisional repair_required, and spawns no Vector 1 child.
The F4 repair lifecycle opens a new state with a recaptured contract snapshot, limits reuse to identity-checked mechanical census, and re-adjudicates affected verdicts rather than inheriting them.
The F5 limited-only case refuses a blanket proceed-anyway, requires named choices, and runs only the bounded scope named in a recorded authorization.
The F8 docs-only spec rewrite is a real deliverable explained via documents/specifies with no phantom code or behavior claim and no forced code invariant.
The F10 generated bulk case uses EXCLUDED only with evidence-linked policy, leaving residue UNRESOLVED with basis unknown rather than speculative UNCLAIMED.
Supplementary fixture F7 asserts no source-to-deliverable edge is accepted so self-ratifying or mutually ratifying docs stay unexplained.
